observer_note: Sam: thought they were lanterns. they were not lanterns.
Frodo stared. took two tries to get him walking again.
the guide counted them and would not say the number.
Frodo half in the water; Sam pulled him out by the collar.
the lights keep office hours. the faces do not.
a winged shadow passed over, westward. all three lay flat in the mud.
last two lights. nobody said goodbye to them.
no instrument was used; the instrument would have been looked into.
